description: FlowMatrix-AI marketing sites that have completed the npmjs migration. Identical to `marketing-site` except that it points the `@flowmatrix-ai` scope at the public registry. This exists because `default.json` sets `npmrc` to npm.pkg.github.com, and THAT is what Renovate writes into a regenerated lockfile - the `registryUrls` packageRule in default.json only governs version LOOKUP, not the `resolved` URLs npm records. So on a migrated site (no committed .npmrc, all three @flowmatrix-ai/site-* packages published to npmjs) lock file maintenance silently rewrote every @flowmatrix-ai entry back to GitHub Packages, and the next `npm ci` died with `401 Unauthorized ... authentication token not provided` because nothing supplies a token any more. Observed on site-marketfourseasons-main#66: main carried 0 GitHub Packages URLs, the lock-file-maintenance branch carried 3. Extend THIS preset, not `marketing-site`, once a site's package-lock.json is free of npm.pkg.github.com. Sites that still consume a GitHub-Packages-only package (@flowmatrix-ai/brand, site-generator, checkout-*) must stay on `marketing-site` - npm scopes a registry per SCOPE, not per package, so the two cannot be mixed in one repo.
